title: 49. How can I allow participants to print or download their contribution?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How can I allow participants to print or download their contribution.
short_answer: If activated, this feature allows participants to save their answers in PDF format.
procedure: To activate this feature, follow the steps below:
1. Open your survey 2. Go to 'Properties' tab 3. Go to 'Security' tab 4. Enable 'Allows participants to print their contribution and receive it as a PDF' option
